claims.text: When asyncio.wait_for times out, it cancels the awaited task and raises TimeoutError.

citations.excerpt: If a timeout occurs, it cancels the task and raises TimeoutError.

claims.text: The total wait time may exceed the timeout because wait_for waits until the future is actually cancelled; if an exception happens during cancellation, it is propagated.

citations.excerpt: The function will wait until the future is actually cancelled, so the total wait time may exceed the timeout. If an exception happens during cancellation, it is propagated.
Changed in version 3.7: When aw is cancelled due to a timeout, wait_for waits for aw to be cancelled. Previously, it raised TimeoutError immediately.
